purpose: Development-only fixed-trajectory test of the frozen coherent reachability observation operator at the five actual PMFS source-update times for H01 seeds 0..9.

scientific_freeze.observation_unit: first 80 samples of each completed stationary physical stop
scientific_freeze.candidate_detection_probability: Jeffreys one-realization posterior predictive: miss=0.25, hit=0.75
scientific_freeze.transport_marginalization: one coherent run-persistent member across all visible physical stops, uniform member prior
scientific_freeze.prior: frozen geometry_prior from each existing bank view
scientific_freeze.posterior: geometry_prior times coherent CTRE likelihood; no blend, temperature, reset, learned weight, truth gate, or PMFS posterior input
scientific_freeze.formal_metric: PMFS ExpectedValue(sourceProbability, 0.05), reproduced on the native 626 free cells

primary_endpoint: final update formal localization error, paired against contemporaneous archived PMFS OFF

go_rule.catastrophe_definition: CTRE error exceeds PMFS error by more than 1.0 m and is greater than 1.5 times PMFS error
